Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:
Creeping infection
[thn] Strike: make a hand strike and put this card on the opposing 
minion. You still control this card. When this striking vampire 
announces an action, you may burn this card to prevent this minion from 
blocking. A minion may have only one Creeping Infection.

[THN] As [thn] above, and this striking vampire gets +1 bleed when 
bleeding this minion's controller.


At THN, is the +1 bleed:

a) for as long as they still control the minion, regardless of whether 
they still have the card
b) only on the action in which you burn the card for the inferior effect
c) only when the minion has this card on it (and thus goes away if you 
use the inferior ability)
d) Other?

Thanks,

-- 
salem
(replace 'hotmail' with 'gmail' to email)
(yes, I am playing a Samedi deck with this card in it!)
